defs.def: to bring things together from different people or places 收集；采集

ex.s: They consist of an electric motor which collects energy used in the braking action that would be lost as heat by conventional brakes.
ex.t: 它们由一个电动机构成，该电机收集制动过程中原本会被传统刹车以热量形式耗散的能量。

ex.s: Collect samples of plant root systems.
ex.t: 收集植物根系的样本。

ex.s: What do we know about the records of species collected now?
ex.t: 关于现在收集到的物种记录，我们知道什么？

ex.s: To collect details for writing novels.
ex.t: 为写小说收集细节。

ex.s: I found myself working with a robotics professor on techniques for collecting data from the desert remotely.
ex.t: 我发现自己正与一位机器人学教授合作，研究从沙漠远程收集数据的技术。

ex.s: From which of the following is the sugar tax collected?
ex.t: 糖税是从下列哪项中征收的？

ex.s: It involves collecting furniture from homes.
ex.t: 包括从家庭收集家具。

ex.s: I began collecting newspaper articles about new species, new monkey, new spider…, and on and on they appear.
ex.t: 我开始收集关于新物种、新猴子、新蜘蛛……的报纸文章，它们源源不断地出现。

ex.s: process collected data             D. reduce air pollution
ex.t: 处理所收集的数据 D. 减少空气污染

ex.s: Data collected from the device could be used to recognize different participants based on how they typed, with very low error rates.
ex.t: 从设备中收集的数据可用于根据不同的参与者的打字方式识别不同的参与者，错误率非常低。

ex.s: To collect data for her report.
ex.t: 为她的报告收集数据。

ex.s: Collect a second proposal from the participant．
ex.t: D．向参与者收集第二份提案。

ex.s: Wang collected more than 7 million abandoned bricks of different ages.
ex.t: 王先生收集了700多万块不同时期的废弃砖块。

ex.s: I enjoyed studying difference kings of cars and planes, playing pop music, and collecting the late music albums.
ex.t: 我喜欢研究不同种类的汽车和飞机，演奏流行音乐，收集最新的音乐专辑。

ex.s: First they collected sound data from 67 nests in four sites in Queensland before and after hatching.
ex.t: 首先，他们在孵化前后从昆士兰州四个地点的67个巢穴收集声音数据。

ex.s: The data collected from Queensland’s locals.
ex.t: 来自昆士兰当地的数据。

ex.s: Google initially used the data collected from users to target advertising better.
ex.t: 谷歌最初利用从用户处收集的数据来更好地定向投放广告。

ex.s: They collect enormous private data.
ex.t: 它们收集大量私人数据。

ex.s: I collect coins and notes.
ex.t: 我收集硬币和纸币。

ex.s: When learning about a new topic, it is important to collect facts and figures.
ex.t: 在了解新主题时，收集事实和数据非常重要。

ex.s: Many people have the hobby of collecting things, eg stamps, postcards or antiques.
ex.t: 许多人都有收集东西的爱好，例如邮票、明信片或古董。

ex.s: The digital age also enables us to find people who share our interests, such as collecting model cars or playing an unusual instrument.
ex.t: 数字时代也使我们能够找到与我们有共同兴趣的人，例如收集模型汽车或演奏不寻常的乐器。

ex.s: We could also say In the digital age, we are able to find people who have the same interests as we do, such as collecting model cars or playing an unusual instrument.
ex.t: 我们还可以说，在数字时代，我们能够找到与我们有着相同兴趣的人，比如收集模范汽车或者演奏一种不寻常的乐器。

ex.s: The most rewarding day for our group was project day，when all the efforts we put into collecting the items finally came together．When I saw the various supplies we had collected，it hit me that every kit we were to build that day would eventually be in the hands of an Iraqi child．Over the past four months，I had never imagined how I would feel once our project was completed．While making the kits，I realized that I had lost sight of the true meaning behind it．I had only focused on the fact that it was another school project and one I wanted to get a good grade on．When the kits were completed，and ready to be sent overseas，the warm feeling I had was one I would never forget．
ex.t: 对我们小组来说最有收获的一天是项目日，那天我们为收集物资付出的所有努力终于汇聚在一起。当我看到我们收集到的各种物资时，我突然意识到，那天我们要制作的每一个套装最终都会送到一个伊拉克孩子手中。在过去的四个月里，我从未想象过项目完成后自己会有怎样的感受。在制作这些套装的过程中，我意识到自己已经忽略了它背后的真正意义——我只顾着把它当成又一个学校项目，而且是我想要拿高分的一个。当这些套装制作完成、准备送往海外时，那种温暖的感觉我将永远铭记。

ex.s: In the race to document the species on Earth before they go extinct, researchers and citizen scientists have collected billions of records.
ex.t: 在赶在物种灭绝前记录地球物种的竞赛中，研究人员和公民科学家已收集了数十亿条记录。

ex.s: What was the author’s initial purpose of collecting newspaper articles?
ex.t: 作者最初收集报纸文章的目的是什么？

ex.s: Made of 168,000 plastic straws collected from several volunteer beach cleanups, the sculpture made its first appearance at the Estella Place shopping center in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.
ex.t: 由从几次志愿者海滩清理中收集的168,000根塑料吸管制成，这座雕塑首次亮相于越南胡志明市的Estella Place购物中心。

ex.s: The 80,000 objects collected by Sir Hans Sloane, for example,    38    （form）the core collection of the British Museum     39    opened in 1759.
ex.t: 例如，Hans Sloane 爵士收集的 80,000 件物品____38____（form）该博物馆的核心藏品。

defs.def: to buy or find things of a particular type and keep them as a hobby 收藏；搜集；收集

ex.s: In the 18th and 19th centuries,    36    （wealth）people travelled and collected plants, historical objects and works of art.
ex.t: 在18和19世纪，36（wealth）富裕的人四处旅行，收集植物、历史物品和艺术品。

ex.s: The two of them collected more than 1,000 plastic bottles along the 40-day journey.
ex.t: 两人在40天的旅途中收集了1000多个塑料瓶。

defs.def: to come together in one place to form a larger group 聚集；集合；汇集
to gradually increase in amount in a place; to gradually obtain more and more of sth in a place 聚积；积聚；积累
to go somewhere in order to take sb/sth away 领取；收走；接走

ex.s: Note: Replacement cards will be available for you to collect seven working days after making the request As a security measure, you are requested to collect your card in person at the SAC.
ex.t: 注：补办的卡将在你提出申请七个工作日后可供领取。作为一项安全措施，你被要求在SAC当面领取你的卡。

defs.def: to ask people to give you money for a particular purpose 募捐；募集

ex.s: To collect money for schools.
ex.t: 改善饮料质量。

ex.s: The government has collected money.
ex.t: 政府已经筹集了资金。

defs.def: to obtain the money, etc. that sb owes, for example by going to their house to get it 收（欠款）；（上门）收（账）

ex.s: “My sales policy is not to collect a single penny.
ex.t: “我的销售政策是不收取一分钱。

ex.s: His artistic talent was discovered by accident when he was sent to the poet Wang Wei’s house to collect payment for some wine.
ex.t: 他的艺术才华是在被派去诗人王维家收酒钱时偶然发现的。

defs.def: to receive sth; to win sth 收到；赢得；获得

ex.s: They enjoyed hearing about all the forbidden fruit I had collected.
ex.t: 后来有一个圣诞节，我收到了一份惊喜礼物——一个大而精美的木箱子，是我儿子Bruce把我那个想象的奶奶的箱子变成了现实。

defs.def: to try to control your emotions and become calm （尽力）镇定下来，歛神专注
to prepare yourself mentally for sth 为 … 做好精神准备

ex.s: The unwilling parent organizes the meal schedule, sends out emails, and collects money for end-of-season gifts.
ex.t: 那位不情愿的家长安排用餐时间表、发送电子邮件，并为赛季末礼物筹集资金。
